findings.one_line: The certified-quadrature/branch-and-bound theorem has an evaluable deliverable, but its novelty positioning never substantively compares its model-specific oracle and finite receipts with the cited validated-numerics and derivative-free global-optimization work (CorlissRall1987; JanssonKnuppel1995); add precise relevance and theorem-level distinctions rather than leaving those bibliography entries unsupported.
